title: instance.network Facet
description: Demanded by the awsec2 Syncer Contract (charter §1.1; ADR-0095). The network placement of a cloud instance Entity — emitted by normalizeInstance, validated at the Projector write path.

privateDnsName.description: The instance's private DNS name (ip-10-0-1-7.ec2.internal). WIDENED IN PLACE by ADR-0143 rather than versioned as a sibling — a Facet on a rebuildable projection is not a wire Contract with external authors, so an optional property is backward-compatible widening (the precedent ADR-0132 D3 cites, itself citing ADR-0117 D5a widening the closed mgmt.address schema with port). It earns its place under §1.1 by being what makes the reach coordinate AUDITABLE: mgmt.address for an instance resolves to this name, and without it projected the operator would see a coordinate appearing nowhere else in the graph and could not tell where it came from (§1.8).

vpcId.description: the VPC the instance is placed in

subnetId.description: the subnet the instance is placed in

availabilityZone.description: the AZ the instance runs in
